data.name: Choozle!
data.detailed_description:
A diorama-style 3D puzzle adventure game

Story

Choo Choo, the conductor of a space train,
gets into an accident with a constellation on the way home from work.

As a result, several stars fall onto the planets below.

Before the gods discover what happened,
Choo Choo must recover the scattered stars
and restore the broken constellations.

Players travel across different planets, solve puzzles,
and return the lost stars to their rightful places in the sky.

Game Overview

The core mechanic of the game revolves around
using the state changes of flower buds to solve puzzles.

There are four different types of flower buds,
each with unique properties:

  • Fairy Bud : Grows nearby plants and objects.

  • Spore Bud : Destroys obstructive plants.

  • Sparkle Bud : Removes petrification effects.

  • Petrified Bud : A disabled bud that cannot perform any function.

Players must strategically use the interactions and transformations between these buds
to create paths and overcome obstacles.

Gameplay Goals

The objective of each stage is to collect the hidden star.

In addition, the game features optional challenges and collectibles,
encouraging players to further explore each map and complete their collection.

After collecting all the stars across the four planet stages,
the constellation is restored and the journey comes to an end.

(Hidden stages can also be discovered throughout the maps!)
